Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_04825_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_04825_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_04825(
    output  wire            ss,         
    output  wire            sck,        
    output  wire            mosi,       
    input   wire            miso,       
    input   wire            clk,        
    input   wire            rst,        
    input   wire            en,         
    input   wire            oe,         
    input   wire            we,         
    input   wire            cpol,       
    input   wire            cpha,       
    input   wire    [ 3:0]  xfer_len,   
    output  wire            busy,       
    output  wire            done,       
    inout   wire    [15:0]  data        
    );

    wire                    i_load, i_en, tbuf_mosi_oe;

    // Internal signal declarations
    reg     [15:0]  data_reg;    // Data register
    reg             done_reg;    // Done signal register

    // Data path logic
    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst) begin
            data_reg <= 16'b0;
            done_reg <= 1'b0;
        end else if (en) begin
            if (we) begin
                data_reg <= data;
                done_reg <= 1'b1;
            end else if (oe) begin
                data_reg <= data_reg;
                done_reg <= 1'b1;
            end else begin
                done_reg <= 1'b0;
            end
        end else begin
            done_reg <= 1'b0;
        end
    end

    assign mosi = data_reg[15];
    assign done = done_reg;
    assign data = (oe) ? data_reg : 16'bz;
    assign i_load = we;
    assign i_en = en;
    assign tbuf_mosi_oe = oe;

    // Controller logic
    reg [3:0] xfer_count;
    wire spi_clk;
    reg sck_reg, sck_next, ss_reg, ss_next;
    reg [3:0] bit_count;
    reg busy_reg;

    // Clock generation based on CPHA and CPOL
    assign spi_clk = (cpol ^ cpha) ? ~clk : clk;

    always @(posedge spi_clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst) begin
            sck_reg <= cpol;
            ss_reg <= 1'b1;
            bit_count <= 4'd0;
            busy_reg <= 1'b0;
        end else if (en) begin
            if (i_load) begin
                ss_reg <= 1'b0;
                busy_reg <= 1'b1;
                bit_count <= xfer_len;
            end else if (busy_reg) begin
                if (bit_count > 4'd0) begin
                    sck_reg <= ~sck_reg;
                    if (sck_reg == cpol) begin
                        bit_count <= bit_count - 4'd1;
                    end
                end else begin
                    busy_reg <= 1'b0;
                    ss_reg <= 1'b1;
                end
            end
        end else begin
            ss_reg <= 1'b1;
        end
    end

    assign ss = ss_reg;
    assign sck = sck_reg;
    assign busy = busy_reg;

endmodule
